svg.title: Rival 1 · working launch — orthographic overhead
svg.desc: Detailed editable vector interpretation of Rival 1 · working launch from Urchin Skipper. True vertical top view, bow up, transparent background. Reference-specific hull, cabin, deck layout and equipment. Weathered paint, fine vector material grain, metal fittings, rails and ropes. All geometry, gradients and patterns are vector artwork; there is no embedded raster image.
svg.metadata: Authored 2026-09-18. Reference: assets/source/boat-sheet-individuals/rival1.png. Designer-supplied originals retained. Reproducible recipe: python3 assets/vectors/create-fleet.py rival1. Shared vector fittings: create-workboat.py. Standalone artwork; no changes to the live fleet, camera, collision geometry or game behavior. Browser and game checks omitted at the designer's request.
